title: Responsive homepage audit and accessible navigation rebuild
what: Audits a synthetic homepage at 375, 768 and 1440px with heuristic Lighthouse-style checks, then rebuilds its navigation as a responsive, keyboard-operable menu.
shows: Before/after audit reports per viewport, overflow detection, and a nav with aria-expanded toggle, Escape close and visible focus, verified in headless Chromium.
checks: original page flags viewport, alt, lang, nav and overflow issues
rebuilt page scores 100 at all three viewports
nav has toggle aria attributes, focus styles and Escape handling
scores never decrease as viewport widens
done: Before/after reports in Markdown and JSON
Unit tests and headless browser check
remaining: Real Lighthouse run on the production homepage
Port nav into production stack and branding
Redesign remaining sections with design team
Screen reader, cross-browser testing and deployment
limits: Synthetic page only; heuristic checks, not real Lighthouse metrics; no visual design or production site touched.
